title: scrophularia canina subsp. hoppei
intro: Scrophularia canina subsp. hoppei, commonly known as Hoppe's figwort, is a plant species in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to support the immune system and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Hoppe's figwort include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, as well as its potential to support digestive health and reduce symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Hoppe's figwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
